text: Code reviews are an essential part of modern software development. When developers review each other's code before it is merged, they can catch bugs early, which saves time and money later. Code reviews also support knowledge sharing, because team members learn different approaches and understand parts of the system they might not normally work on. In addition, regular reviews help maintain team quality by keeping the codebase consistent and readable. Although code reviews take extra effort, they are a valuable investment. Teams that review code regularly tend to produce more reliable software and work better together.
